name: Web Dev: Redesign & Performance Modernization
description: Identifies established local businesses with active revenue but broken, slow, or missing websites.
targetNiche: High-margin local services (Clinics, Law firms, Contractors, High-end Dining)

rules.name: Minimum Established Business (>= 15 Reviews)
rules.description: Ensures the business is actively operating and generates client flow.
rules.failureExplanation: Disqualified: Less than 15 Google reviews indicates early-stage or inactive business.

rules.name: Direct Phone Number Present
rules.description: Outreach channel requirement: Must have a phone number to pitch.
rules.failureExplanation: Disqualified: Missing phone number makes direct sales outreach impossible.

rules.name: Exclude Competitor Digital / Web Agencies
rules.description: Rejects other digital marketing or web development agencies.
rules.explanation: Disqualified: Identified as a peer digital agency / software firm.

rules.name: Exclude Massive Enterprise Hospital Chains
rules.description: Enterprise healthcare chains require procurement contracts, not agency pitches.
rules.explanation: Disqualified: National enterprise chain with dedicated internal IT.

rules.name: No Website Detected (+30 pts)
rules.description: High-intent need: Actively operating with reviews but zero web presence.
rules.explanation: Critical Need: Established business has no website; prime candidate for fresh build.

rules.name: Poor Overall Website Quality (< 60) (+20 pts)
rules.description: Existing website score is below modern standards.
rules.explanation: Technical Need: Overall website quality score is low (<60), signaling redesign opportunity.

rules.name: Slow Mobile / Performance Score (< 50) (+15 pts)
rules.description: Poor loading performance damages conversion rates.
rules.explanation: Performance Deficit: Website performance is severely impaired (<50).

rules.name: Missing or Invalid SSL (+15 pts)
rules.description: Insecure website warnings scare away visitors.
rules.explanation: Security Deficit: Missing SSL certificate causes browser security warnings.

rules.name: High Ability to Pay (>= 100 Reviews) (+20 pts)
rules.description: Indicates high customer turnover and budget to invest in web infrastructure.
rules.explanation: Budget Indicator: High review count (>=100) confirms strong revenue capacity.

name: Marketing: Local SEO & Paid Acquisition
description: Targets high-rated businesses that lack organic search optimization or analytics instrumentation.

rules.name: Good Reputation (Rating >= 4.0)
rules.failureExplanation: Disqualified: Reputation rating below 4.0 makes marketing harder to convert.

rules.name: Must Have an Active Website
rules.failureExplanation: Disqualified: SEO services require an active website.

rules.name: Poor SEO Score (< 50) (+35 pts)
rules.explanation: High Opportunity: SEO score is below 50, indicating major optimization potential.

rules.name: Active Social Presence But Weak Web (+25 pts)
rules.explanation: Cross-Channel Gap: Business is active on social media but leaking web traffic.

rules.name: Strong Local Authority (>= 50 Reviews) (+20 pts)
rules.explanation: Authority: Strong customer base ready for local search dominance.

rules.name: Identified Decision Maker (+20 pts)
rules.explanation: High Reachability: Owner or decision-maker contact identified.
